item.title: [IGNITE-26152] Fix node stop hang during snapshot creation.
item.description:
The "Snapshots 1" suite hangs every 10th run. This issue can be reproduced locally by running the `testCrdChangeDuringHandlerCompleteOnSnapshotCreate` test (failure rate of about 1 in 5-15 runs).
